exposure: Women who underwent instrumental vaginal birth
outcome: Quality of maternal and newborn care (QMNC)
Information provided on newborn after cesarean
Information provided on maternal and newborn danger signs
cohort: Women who gave birth in Switzerland during the COVID-19 pandemic (n=1175)
finding: Women giving birth in Switzerland during the COVID-19 pandemic reported notable gaps in QMNC, particularly in communication, staffing, and information provision.
mod_finding: Women who experienced cesarean or instrumental vaginal birth reported significantly lower QMNC compared to those who had vaginal births.
